description: Perform bulk metadata operations on multiple documents simultaneously: set correspondent/type/storage path, manage tags, reprocess, rotate, merge or split. Deletion, page removal and permission changes are not available in this mode.

add_tags.description: Array of tag IDs to add when method is 'modify_tags'. Use list_tags to get valid IDs.

correspondent.description: ID of correspondent to assign when method is 'set_correspondent'. Use list_correspondents to get valid IDs.

degrees.description: Rotation angle in degrees when method is 'rotate'. Use 90, 180, or 270 for standard rotations.

document_type.description: ID of document type to assign when method is 'set_document_type'. Use list_document_types to get valid IDs.

documents.description: Array of document IDs to perform bulk operations on. Get document IDs from search_documents first.

metadata_document_id.description: Source document ID when merging documents. The metadata from this document will be preserved.

method.description: The bulk operation to perform: set_correspondent (assign sender/receiver), set_document_type (categorize documents), set_storage_path (organize file location), add_tag/remove_tag/modify_tags (manage labels), reprocess (re-run OCR/indexing), merge (combine documents into a new one, keeping the originals), split (separate one document into several along the ranges given in 'pages', keeping the original), rotate (adjust orientation). Deleting documents or pages and replacing permissions are not available: this server was not started with destructive operations enabled.

pages.description: Page specification for the 'split' method: comma-separated page ranges, each of which becomes a new document. '1-2,3-4' splits a four-page document into two. Required by 'split' and ignored by every other method available here.

remove_tags.description: Array of tag IDs to remove when method is 'modify_tags'. Use list_tags to get valid IDs.

storage_path.description: ID of storage path to assign when method is 'set_storage_path'. Storage paths organize documents in folder hierarchies.

tag.description: Single tag ID to add or remove when method is 'add_tag' or 'remove_tag'. Use list_tags to get valid IDs.

name: bulk_edit_documents

description: Create a new correspondent (person, company, or organization) for tracking document senders and receivers. Can include automatic matching patterns for smart assignment to incoming documents.

match.description: Text pattern to automatically assign this correspondent to matching documents. Use names, email addresses, or keywords that appear in documents from this correspondent.

matching_algorithm.description: How to match text patterns: 'any'=any word matches, 'all'=all words must match, 'exact'=exact phrase match, 'regular expression'=use regex patterns, 'fuzzy'=approximate matching with typos. Default is 'any'.

name.description: Name of the correspondent (person, company, or organization that sends/receives documents). Examples: 'Bank of America', 'John Smith', 'Electric Company'.

name: create_correspondent

description: Create a new document type for categorizing documents by their purpose or format (e.g., Invoice, Receipt, Contract). Can include automatic matching rules for smart classification.

match.description: Text pattern to automatically assign this document type to matching documents. Use keywords that commonly appear in this type of document (e.g., 'invoice', 'receipt', 'contract terms').

matching_algorithm.description: How to match text patterns: 'any'=any word matches, 'all'=all words must match, 'exact'=exact phrase match, 'regular expression'=use regex patterns, 'fuzzy'=approximate matching with typos. Default is 'any'.

name.description: Name of the document type for categorizing documents by their purpose or format. Examples: 'Invoice', 'Receipt', 'Contract', 'Letter', 'Bank Statement', 'Tax Document'.

name: create_document_type

description: Create a new tag for labeling and organizing documents. Tags can have colors for visual identification and automatic matching rules for smart assignment.

color.description: Hex color code for visual identification (e.g., '#FF0000' for red, '#00FF00' for green). If not provided, Paperless assigns a random color.

match.description: Text pattern to automatically assign this tag to matching documents. Use keywords, phrases, or regular expressions depending on matching_algorithm.

matching_algorithm.description: How to match text patterns: 0=any word, 1=all words, 2=exact phrase, 3=regular expression, 4=fuzzy matching. Default is 0 (any word).

name.description: Tag name for labeling and organizing documents (e.g., 'important', 'taxes', 'receipts'). Must be unique and descriptive.

name: create_tag

description: Download a document file as base64-encoded data. Choose between original uploaded file or processed/archived version with OCR improvements.

id.description: Document ID to download. Get this from search_documents or get_document results.

original.description: Whether to download the original uploaded file (true) or the processed/archived version (false, default). Original files preserve exact formatting but may not include OCR improvements.

name: download_document

description: Retrieve a single correspondent by its ID, including its name and matching rules. Useful for resolving a correspondent name from an ID referenced by a document when it is not on the first page of list_correspondents.

id.description: ID of the correspondent to retrieve. Document objects reference correspondents by these IDs.

name: get_correspondent

description: Get complete details for a specific document including full metadata, content preview, tags, correspondent, and document type information.

id.description: Unique document ID. Get this from search_documents results. Returns full document metadata, content preview, and associated tags/correspondent/type.

name: get_document

description: Retrieve a single document type by its ID, including its name and matching rules. Useful for resolving a document type name from an ID referenced by a document when it is not on the first page of list_document_types.

id.description: ID of the document type to retrieve. Document objects reference document types by these IDs.

name: get_document_type

description: Retrieve a single tag by its ID, including its name, color, and matching rules. Useful for resolving a tag name from an ID referenced by a document when the tag is not on the first page of list_tags.

id.description: ID of the tag to retrieve. Document objects reference tags by these IDs.

name: get_tag

description: Retrieve available correspondents (people, companies, organizations that send/receive documents). Returns names and automatic matching patterns for document assignment. Results are paginated (25 per page by default); use page/page_size to enumerate large correspondent collections.

page.description: 1-based page number to retrieve. Paperless returns 25 results per page by default; use this together with the `next`/`count` fields in the response to enumerate all entries.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Increase this (e.g. 1000) to fetch all entries in a single call instead of paging.

name: list_correspondents

description: Retrieve available document types for categorizing documents by purpose or format (Invoice, Receipt, Contract, etc.). Returns names and automatic matching rules. Results are paginated (25 per page by default); use page/page_size to enumerate large collections.

page.description: 1-based page number to retrieve. Paperless returns 25 results per page by default; use this together with the `next`/`count` fields in the response to enumerate all entries.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Increase this (e.g. 1000) to fetch all entries in a single call instead of paging.

name: list_document_types

description: Retrieve available tags for labeling and organizing documents. Returns tag names, colors, and matching rules for automatic assignment. Results are paginated (25 per page by default); use page/page_size to enumerate large tag collections.

page.description: 1-based page number to retrieve. Paperless returns 25 results per page by default; use this together with the `next`/`count` fields in the response to enumerate all entries.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Increase this (e.g. 1000) to fetch all entries in a single call instead of paging.

name: list_tags

description: Upload a new document to Paperless-NGX with metadata. Supports PDF, images (PNG/JPG/TIFF), and text files. Automatically processes for OCR and indexing.

archive_serial_number.description: Custom archive number for document organization and reference. Useful for maintaining external filing systems.

correspondent.description: ID of the correspondent (sender/receiver) for this document. Use list_correspondents to find or create_correspondent to add new ones.

created.description: Document creation date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss). If not provided, uses current date.

custom_fields.description: Array of custom field IDs to associate with this document. Custom fields store additional metadata.

document_type.description: ID of document type for categorization (e.g., Invoice, Receipt, Letter). Use list_document_types to find or create_document_type to add new ones.

file.description: Base64 encoded file content. Convert your file to base64 before uploading. Supports PDF, images (PNG, JPG, TIFF), and text files.

filename.description: Original filename with extension (e.g., 'invoice.pdf', 'receipt.png'). This helps Paperless determine file type and initial document title.

storage_path.description: ID of storage path to organize document location in folder hierarchy. Leave empty for default storage.

tags.description: Array of tag IDs to label this document. Use list_tags to find existing tags or create_tag to add new ones.

title.description: Custom document title. If not provided, Paperless will extract title from filename or document content.

name: post_document

description: Search through documents using full-text search across content, titles, tags, and metadata. Returns document metadata WITHOUT the full OCR content field to prevent token overflow. Use get_document to retrieve full details for specific documents of interest. Supports Paperless-NGX advanced query syntax.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starts at 1). Use to browse through large result sets without hitting token limits.

page_size.description: Number of documents per page (default 25, max 100). Smaller page sizes help avoid token limits when many documents match.

query.description: Search query using Paperless-NGX syntax. By default, matches documents containing ALL words. Advanced syntax: Field searches: 'tag:unpaid', 'type:invoice', 'correspondent:university'. Logical operators: 'term1 AND (term2 OR term3)'. Date ranges: 'created:[2020 to 2024]', 'added:yesterday', 'modified:today'. Wildcards: 'prod*name'. Combine multiple criteria as needed. Search looks through document content, title, correspondent, type, and tags.

name: search_documents

description: Update metadata for an existing document. Use this to correct or set the document date, title, correspondent, document type, tags, and other fields on a document that is already in Paperless-NGX.

archive_serial_number.description: Archive serial number for physical document cross-reference, or null to clear.

correspondent.description: ID of correspondent to assign, or null to clear. Use list_correspondents to get valid IDs.

created.description: Document date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss). Use this to set the date to the actual date on the document — Paperless often defaults to the upload/scan date instead.

document_type.description: ID of document type to assign, or null to clear. Use list_document_types to get valid IDs.

id.description: Unique document ID to update. Get this from list_documents, search_documents, or get_document.

storage_path.description: ID of storage path to assign, or null to use default.

tags.description: Full list of tag IDs to assign. Replaces all existing tags on the document. Use list_tags to get valid IDs.

name: update_document

description: Modify an existing tag's name, color, or automatic matching rules. Useful for refining tag organization and improving automatic document classification.

color.description: New hex color code for visual identification (e.g., '#FF0000' for red). Leave empty to keep current color.

id.description: ID of the tag to update. Use list_tags to find existing tag IDs.

match.description: Text pattern for automatic tag assignment. Empty string removes auto-matching. Use keywords, phrases, or regex depending on matching_algorithm.

matching_algorithm.description: Algorithm for pattern matching: 0=any word, 1=all words, 2=exact phrase, 3=regular expression, 4=fuzzy matching.

name.description: New tag name. Must be unique among all tags.

name: update_tag
